# VeriAgent Pay: Comprehensive Technical & Protocol Guide

## 1. Executive Summary
VeriAgent Pay is an interoperable, self-custodial social payment and yield automation protocol. It bridges conversational chat platforms (Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Slack) with high-performance blockchain settlement layers (BOTChain L1 and Stellar Soroban) using WebAuthn P-256 passkey cryptography and ERC-4337 account abstraction.

## 2. Core Protocol Architecture

### 2.1 Smart Account & Passkey Security
- **Asymmetric Cryptography**: Accounts are secured using WebAuthn / FIDO2 standards. Passkeys are generated inside the user device's Secure Enclave / Trusted Execution Environment (TEE).
- **Zero Raw Biometric Exposure**: Raw biometrics (Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint templates) never leave the client device. Only the public key (P-256 curve) is registered on-chain with the smart account.
- **Session Keys & Policy Delegation**: Users can grant scoped, short-lived session keys for instant micro-transactions and AI auto-saving. Session keys enforce strict spending ceilings, time limits, and action boundaries.
- **Self-Custody**: The user remains the sole owner of their smart account. Neither VeriAgent Pay, relayers, nor bots can transfer funds without valid cryptographic signatures.

### 2.2 Gasless Settlement & Sponsorship
- **BOTChain L1**: Uses gas paymasters and ERC-4337 bundlers to sponsor gas fees, enabling $0 transaction cost for end-users.
- **Stellar Soroban**: Employs fee-bump transaction relayers and SEP-43 / Passkey Kit smart wallet helpers for gasless operations.

### 2.3 Conversational Social Payments
- **Telegram Bot (@VeriAgentPayBot)**: Full-featured bot interface for sending money, checking balances, claiming red envelopes, and contributing to pools.
- **Multi-Platform Continuity**: User accounts and balances stay synchronized across Web Dashboard, Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, and Slack.

### 2.4 Yield Vaults & zkTLS Attestation
- **Auto-Save**: Users can allocate idle USDT balances into audited yield vaults.
- **zkTLS Cryptographic Verification**: Yield percentages and protocol attestations are verified using Veridex zkTLS proof network, ensuring transparent and verifiable returns.
